That only hadrat Nuh had children. Hence Hadrat Nuh is like the second Adam (alayhis salam). Is this true? Question: Asslamu aleykum When the storm hit at the time of Hadrat Nuh (alayhis salam) is it true that all the people that were on board, didnt have children? That only hadrat Nuh had children..Hence Hadrat Nuh is like the second Adam (alayhis salam). Is this true? Answer ID: 730 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 311=305/M) In the books of Tafseer, it is mentioned that Hazrat Noah (Alahis Salaam) boarded the ship (ark) with his family and people with necessary articles. But, there is no mention whether his followers had children or not; therefore we can not give any positive or negative judgement. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
